# Continuing with the Plane Crash Data from Class 11. From: <https://www.planecrashinfo.com/>
```{r}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page


# How many <table> elements are on the page?
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

# From a cleaning perspectice:
# [1] Translate crash_tables into a data frame
# [2] To replace the current headers with row 1 then delete row 1.
# [3] Convert date into a date column instead of a chr data-type
# [4] More complex cleaning to spit multiple information within a single sell to separate columns (not in today's class).

# data frame
crash_df = crash_tables[[1]]

# clean up headers
colnames(crash_df) = crash_df[1, ]
crash_df = crash_df[-1, ]

# convert date to a date data-type
crash_df = crash_df |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))
dplyr::glimpse(crash_df)



```


# Salvage game:
```{r}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)   # check this first: one per card


```

```{r}
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts))
for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> 
      rvest::html_text2(),
    value = pg |> rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> 
      rvest::html_text2() |> readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)   # 400 rows?

dreadnought_df = registry |> 
  dplyr::filter(class == "Dreadnought")

sum(dreadnought_df$value)
```
